feedback.message: Do not hash host JSON numeric text. Candidate BASE canonicalizer should bind numeric type to semantic identity; general Int lowering must stay exact; F64 literal identity may be bit-based with arithmetic equivalence rules separate.

Exact state/hash identity must distinguish semantic numeric type from host serializer presentation and runtime resource identity.
CTK typed domain payloads need a numeric canonical identity contract; do not put backend JSON formatting into the common header identity.
No FRANK whole-architecture change follows; this is a compiler/runtime identity constraint.
No graph semantic change; preserve logical identity, provenance, activation/admissibility and authority distinctions.
Numeric determinism is not workspace causal-use evidence.
Canonicalization determinism is not evidence of causal emergence.
